blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12) will deploy 4,790 personnel across Soccsksargen (Region 12) to help ensure public safety and maintain peace and order during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day 2026 (Undas 2026). The PRO-12 Regional Public Information said the deployment will cover cemeteries, memorial parks, columbaria, places of worship, major roads, transportation hubs, and tourist destinations. Police personnel will also conduct mobile patrols and man designated checkpoints to monitor public areas and respond to security concerns. PRO-12 Director Brig. Gen.
